deviations: After the first K4 run, validation was strengthened: the initial 30 plants tested their true alphabet row; the final run searches each plant's full registered configuration at its true period. Both runs recover all plants. K4 scope, seeds, filters and interpretation did not change. initial_result.json and initial_run.log preserve the first run.
reference_warning: Reference assumes uniform independent implied key values. Keyword alphabets and crib letter repetitions violate this model; these numbers are not calibrated significance levels.
